artifacts.grain: one strategy plan and accepted candidate taxon

strategies.name: geography_first
strategies.semantics: schedule available regional evidence first, then required safety, family expansion and complete-union remainder

strategies.name: family_first_safe
strategies.semantics: schedule family-priority candidates first while independently retaining the complete target, query, geography, visual and safety union

strategies.name: parallel_family_geography_union
strategies.semantics: merge family, geography, query, visual, target and safety axes independently, followed by complete-union remainder

properties: all strategies schedule one immutable family/geography candidate source set rather than creating competing truth layers
every source candidate appears exactly once in every strategy plan
target preservation and complete-union membership are true for every strategy row
family evidence may change scheduling but never membership
geography-first no-geo inputs retain target and global safety candidates
family-first wrong-family inputs retain the target, geographic, query, visual and explicit safety union
parallel union records every active inclusion axis and deduplicates at accepted-taxon grain
strategy scores and order are raw scheduling evidence, not calibrated probabilities or release authority

strategy_and_target_preservation_suite.command: uv run pytest -q tests/test_candidate_strategy_ablation.py tests/test_family_geo_candidates.py tests/test_regional_candidate_species.py tests/test_visual_neighbour_species.py tests/test_target_aware_scoring.py tests/test_target_aware_fusion.py tests/test_target_aware_output.py tests/test_bioclip_classification_modes.py tests/test_current_reference_pooling_audit.py

artifact_reproducibility.command: bounded five-candidate fixture; build, write, reload and validate all three strategy plans
